rule: the Urban Projects Company Rulebook: OWNER CONFIRMED company rules (hierarchy level 3). Project documents (level 1) and owner project decisions (level 2) override a company value FOR THAT PROJECT ONLY, through the per-project configuration passed to engine/source/company_rulebook_v1.py; they never change this file. Where levels 1-3 are silent, a value may come only from a documented engineering estimate (level 4) carrying its source and sensitivity, labelled ENGINEERING ESTIMATE; otherwise the value is an explicit unresolved exception (level 5) and the quantity is HELD, never 0. A behaviour change is a new version of this file; this file is never edited in place. Owner confirmation of a site practice is not structural design or engineering approval. Rates feed procurement (layer 2) only: net installed quantities, consumption, waste and procurement are kept separate.

hierarchy.1: PROJECT DOCUMENT (approved drawings, specifications, schedules, details; revision and precedence applied)
hierarchy.2: OWNER PROJECT DECISION (explicit, for that project only)
hierarchy.4: ENGINEERING ESTIMATE (documented method, assumption, calculation and sensitivity; never owner-attributed, never VERIFIED procurement)
hierarchy.5: ASSUMPTION-UNRESOLVED (explicit exception: the quantity stays HELD, never 0)

provenance: owner directives 2026-11-02 (main chat), recorded on agents/control in docs/agents/MISSION.md ('OWNER CONFIRMED rules register' and 'Consolidated owner directive 2026-11-02: understand before calculating'), docs/agents/AGENT_BRIEF.md (OWNER CONFIRMED rules table) and docs/agents/OWNER_QUESTIONS_ANSWERED.md (Q-45, Q-60, Q-72, Q-73, Q-75, Q-78); task T-448; 1.1.0 (task T-615): UPC-BLACK-BLOCK-001 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 from Q-80 (owner 2026-11-07, main chat, verbatim in docs/agents/OWNER_QUESTIONS_ANSWERED.md: 'Q-80: 40x20 face, 12.5 blocks/m2 (tell me if the drawings show otherwise)'); every other record is byte-for-byte the 1.0.0 record

records.title: Precast lintel (atab, عتب) stock length and count
records.scope: every villa; precast lintels over masonry openings. White AAC walls usually take white precast lintels (atab only for white blocks, Q-60); black block walls take black precast or cast-in-situ RC lintels as the drawings require (company convention, not structural design). A printed structural lintel schedule or a structural beam that already serves the opening governs instead (never both).

stock_lengths_m.note: 1.00 m is NOT a company stock length; it is used only on a supplier record given as a project override (level 1 / 2)

min_bearing_each_side_m.note: minimum; an approved bearing from the drawings or the supplier load / span table replaces it when larger; the owner's 0.20 m in his example is illustrative, not universal

method: masonry opening width W (the opening in the block, e.g. a 1.00 m clear door may need 1.10 m per the approved door / frame detail), from the drawings; unknown -> HELD
bearing b each side = the approved project bearing (level 1 / 2) when given, else the company minimum 0.15 m; a project bearing below 0.15 m is a CONFLICT, FLAGGED, never silently used
required length = W + 2 b; piece = the shortest stock length >= required; one piece per opening; measured in pieces (nr) by length
required length above the longest stock (4.00 m) -> FLAGGED (cast-in-situ or design), never forced into a stock piece

no capacity check is implied: long spans need the supplier load / span table or the drawing specification; beside an RC column no bearing is assumed on a 10 cm masonry strip (designed connection or FLAGGED)
records.source: owner 2026-11-02 (AGENT_BRIEF 'Lintels'; MISSION OWNER CONFIRMED register 'Lintels' and consolidated directive 'Lintels'); Q-60 (atab only for white blocks)
not_given: lintel section / type per wall type (drawings or supplier)
load / span capacity (supplier tables or drawings)

records.title: Tile adhesive (لاصق) bags by tile size
records.scope: every villa; porcelain / ceramic tiles fixed with cementitious tile adhesive (BSCO NITE C2 / NITE Plus C2TE named by the owner; the cheaper green packaging is not assumed equivalent). Urban practical consumption, not the manufacturer's nominal figure.

coverage_m2_per_bag_by_size_cm.note: size keys are long x short side in cm; 60 x 120 is the same tile as 120 x 60

coverage_m2_per_bag_normal_class.note: 'normal tiles' at 5 m2 per bag; a size not in the table takes this rate ONLY when the project or the owner classifies it NORMAL (level 1 / 2); otherwise the size is HELD, never the 60 x 60 rate

rounding.note: room quantities kept as fractional bags; bags rounded up once per product at the purchasing group (project / product), never per-room rounding summed

waste.note: separate; configurable and evidence-based, never hardcoded; no waste is applied unless a sourced value is given

method: bags_net = net tiled area / coverage of that tile size
bags_to_buy = ceil(sum of bags_net over the purchasing group x (1 + sourced waste, when given))
records.source: Q-45 (owner 2026-10-19: 20 kg bag, 5 m2); owner 2026-11-02 (120 x 60 and 160 x 80 at 3 m2 per bag; normal incl. 60 x 60 at 5 m2; ceil rounding; waste separate)
not_given: any tile size not in the table and not classified NORMAL

records.title: White AAC block glue (مونة طابوق أبيض) consumption
records.scope: every villa; thin-bed glue of white AAC block walls on the net block area (openings deducted, Q-73). Owner site rates; replaces the earlier 'about 10 m2 per bag'. Provenance: a 2025 invoice implied a leaner rate; the owner chose his site rates.

kg_per_m2_by_thickness_m.note: 15 cm block about 7.1 m2 per bag; 20 cm block about 5.6 m2 per bag; any other thickness HELD

method: kg = net AAC wall area x kg/m2 of its thickness
bags_to_buy = ceil(sum kg over the purchasing group x (1 + sourced waste, when given) / 25)
records.source: owner 2026-11-02 (AGENT_BRIEF 'White AAC glue'; MISSION OWNER CONFIRMED register)
not_given: glue rate for 10 / 25 / 30 cm AAC blocks

records.title: Black (cement) block count per m2 of wall
records.scope: every villa; black solid blocks, physical 40 x 19 x 19 cm, sold as 40 x 20 x 20 cm; counted on the INSTALLED module including joints. 12.5 per m2 applies where the installed module is 40 x 20 cm: the 20 cm block (Q-75) and the 15 cm block (Q-80, owner 2026-11-07: 40 x 20 face, 12.5 per m2). A project document (level 1: block schedule, specification, detail note) that PRINTS a different 15 cm block face is REPORTED to the owner and never overridden by the agent: the quantity stays on this rule until the owner rules on the report.

confirmed_modules_m.note: thickness -> installed face module confirmed by the owner: 0.20 m Q-75 (2026-11-02), 0.15 m Q-80 (2026-11-07); any other thickness is NOT stated (HELD, never borrowed)

waste.note: separate; configurable and evidence-based, never a hardcoded 5 %

method: theoretical count = net wall area (openings deducted, Q-73) x 12.5 for a confirmed 40 x 20 module
procurement count = ceil(theoretical x (1 + sourced waste)) kept apart; gross, openings, net, theoretical, waste and procurement traceable separately
a 15 cm block face printed on a drawing / schedule / specification that differs from 40 x 20 is a report to the owner (Q-80 condition), not an override
records.source: Q-75 (owner 2026-11-02 answer: 40 x 19 x 19 sold as 40 x 20 x 20, installed module, 12.5 per m2 only for a confirmed 40 x 20 module, waste separate); Q-80 (owner 2026-11-07: 15 cm block 40 x 20 face, 12.5 per m2, report any drawing that shows otherwise); owner decision 2026-10-23 14:15 (waste configurable)
not_given: the installed module of any black block thickness other than 0.15 m and 0.20 m

records.title: Black-block laying mortar mix and materials per m3
records.scope: every villa; joint mortar of black (cement) block walls only (never borrowed for render or plaster); the mortar volume comes from the joint geometry of the installed module.
method: cement bags = mortar m3 x 8 (rounded up at the purchasing group)
sand m3 = mortar m3 x 1.1 (loose)
records.source: Q-78 (owner 2026-11-02: A, 1:4 with the Q-45 figures); Q-45

records.title: Cement-sand bed under floor tiles
records.scope: every villa; the cement-sand bed under floor tiles (regular floors and wet-area floors, bartash); reported as a RANGE (low = thin, high = thick), never one invented number. Not the wet-wall levelling render (UPC-WETWALL-001).
method: mortar m3 (low, high) = net floor area x (thickness low, high)
cement and sand from the 1:4 figures per bound
records.source: Q-45 (owner 2026-10-19 answer: regular floors 3-4 cm, bathrooms 4-6 cm, 1:4, about 8 bags and 1.1 m3 loose sand per m3)
not_given: roof screed thickness (from the falls on the drawings)
stair marble bed (Q-53, its own rule)

records.title: Wet-area wall build-up: three separate operations
records.scope: every villa; bathrooms, kitchens, pantries, laundry, ironing rooms and other designated wet areas

second_fixing_bed.note: no second mortar fixing bed where render + adhesive is the method

method: each operation is its own BOQ line on the same wet-wall area; none omitted, none double-counted
porcelain to the project finish height under the wet-area rules unless the drawings say otherwise
records.source: owner 2026-11-02 (MISSION OWNER CONFIRMED register 'Wet-area walls'; consolidated directive)
not_given: spatter dash and levelling render thickness / mix / water (see UPC-CEMENT-LAYERS-METHOD-001)

records.title: Plaster and paint heights
records.scope: every villa; interior wall plaster and paint

plaster_top.note: full height above suspended ceilings too, from drawings and sections; not a 10-20 cm band; beam faces, openings and overlapping walls not double counted

stair_shaft.note: continuously through the stairwell from sections, levels, landings and roof geometry; no room-height deductions; reconciled wall by wall

records.source: owner 2026-11-02 (MISSION register 'Wall plaster height', 'Wall paint height', 'Stair shaft'); Q-72

records.title: Opening deduction from blockwork
records.scope: every villa; every actual opening (doors, windows, passages, glass lines) deducted at full size from the block area; no minimum size

records.title: Spatter dash, levelling render, wall plaster and water: documented estimating method (values NOT owner-given)
records.scope: every villa; used only where the project documents (level 1), an owner project decision (level 2) and the company rules (level 3) are silent; the earlier 2 cm 1:4 wet-wall render was an engine assumption and is NOT a company rule; the 1:4 black-block mortar rule applies to black-block mortar only
method: search order: project specification -> drawings -> owner project decision -> company rulebook -> this method
mortar m3 = area x thickness; cement bags and sand m3 = mortar m3 x the per-m3 figures of the applicable mix

a value used here must carry its source (reference book / specification clause) and the label ENGINEERING ESTIMATE; the result shows its sensitivity (mortar m3 per mm of thickness = area / 1000) and is never VERIFIED procurement
with no sourced value the layer's material line is HELD with this method named; the area lines are unaffected (a missing non-critical procurement parameter never blocks the rest of the BOQ)
records.source: owner 2026-11-02 (MISSION 'NOT GIVEN BY THE OWNER' and consolidated directive 'Cement-based materials')
